title: docs(adr-0142): amend D2 — a failed member read refuses for the D7 grant recompute and the D6 approver slate, and still answers nobody for admission consumers
body:
domain:server#4 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbacSXJQqAztgt4UMrS

Filing gate: ② a maintainer decision. Warren picked option B on #29604 at 2026-11-03T03:05Z (decision card in the thread "Decide ruling for card #29604"). B runs in two PRs: this ADR amendment first, then the code on #29604. Sub-issue of #29604, so it carries the parent's domain. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2, as the parent.

## What the amendment says

Governing text: `docs/adr/0142-ownership-queue-membership-claim-and-assignment-rules.md` D2 ("An empty expansion is a fact, not a fault: the consumers below each say what they do with it"), D5 (a failed assignment read leaves the row and warns), D6 item 2 (empty slate warns and returns `[]`), D7 item 1 (an empty queue grants nothing and warns).

Neither D2 nor D6/D7 says what happens when the member table behind a queue cannot be read. Today the expander answers "nobody", so the D7 grant pass is recomputed against an empty set and revokes every grant the queue gave, and a D6 slate shrinks. Every other sharing and approvals recipient read now refuses on a failed read (#29362, #29503 / PR #29602, #29606 / PR #29647).

## Wanted

1. D2 separates **an empty expansion** (a fact) from **a failed read** (a fault), and names who reads which:
   - admission consumers — the access path (D3), the claim admission (D4), the assignment pool (D5) — keep "nobody" on a failed read, because answering nobody denies;
   - the D7 grant recompute and the D6 approver slate refuse on a failed read.
2. D7 adds: a refused grant pass keeps the rule's existing grants and warns (the #29362 posture).
3. D6 adds: a refused slate follows the approvals failure class of #29503.
4. The status line gets an `Amended (2026-11-03, #29604)` note in the shape of the existing one.
5. Nothing else in the record moves. No code, no schema, no changeset in this PR.

## Process

`docs/adr/**` is Tier H: this PR needs the maintainer's approval. It runs at the fable tier with effort xhigh, as the ruling set. The code half (#29604) is dispatched after this PR merges.

Dedupe: searched `ADR-0142 D2 amend`, `queue failed read refuse`; nearest is the parent #29604. **New.**

Links back: #29604 (filing addendum 6588472222, queue-limit comment 6591670782), #29362, #29503, #29606, ADR-0142.
